description: List owner-scoped Slideshow Runs with optional platform, lifecycle status, or search query filters. Returns run metadata, platform target, page counts, revision numbers, and timestamps. Call to browse existing carousels or find a runId before inspection, updating, or archiving. Alternatives: Use get_slideshow_run when you already have a specific runId to fetch full slide content. Behavior: Read-only query scoped to current authenticated workspace owner.

brandId.description: Filter runs styled with a specific Brand ID.

contentSlug.description: Filter runs generated from a specific content topic slug.

platform.description: Target platform filter: tiktok | linkedin | instagram | threads | xiaohongshu

q.description: Search term matching run title, topic, or content text.

status.description: Lifecycle status filter: draft | active | archived | trash

name: list_slideshow_runs

runs.description: Array of slideshow run summary items.

title: List slideshow runs
